prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup
Asset type: high-fidelity desktop web app dashboard concept at 1440×900
Primary request: Redesign the authenticated Wicker Study dashboard as ‘Split Horizon’: immediate academic pressure and course readiness sit side by side, so today never obscures the exam trajectory.
Input images: use the original current Wicker Study screenshot as identity reference for the existing left navigation chrome, warm neutral canvas, condensed headings/numerals, near-black navy ink, and single indigo signal. The two generated sibling concepts are only quality references; do not reuse the Study Itinerary vertical path or the Focus Command recommendation hero.
Composition/framing: exact desktop product UI screenshot, straight-on, no device mockup. Keep the 200px left sidebar. The content begins with a compact header ‘Thursday, 3 September’, ‘Period 1 · week 1 of 8’, a five-period measure, and a tiny 28-day activity spark strip. Below, split the viewport asymmetrically with a crisp vertical seam. The left 38% is ‘Today’: a compact agenda, ‘Nothing scheduled today’, a primary indigo ‘Practice now’ action, and an ordered ‘Coming up’ register with Exam week Period 1 in 39 days, Study week Period 1 in 46 days, exams and resits in 95 days. The right 62% is ‘Course readiness’: a table-like matrix, not cards. Rows are BCS1540 Algorithmic Design and BCS1520 Statistics. Columns show Read, Practice, Mistakes, Exam; use honest values 0%, 15%, —, 39d and understated marks. The Statistics row is the selected/focus row with a soft indigo wash and a ‘Resume’ action. A narrow footer ledger shows Credits 0/60, Courses passed 0/14, Streak 0d.
Style/medium: polished operational academic cockpit, dense and highly scannable, flat ruled regions, strong column alignment, compact labels, one soft selected-row highlight.
Text (verbatim where visible): ‘Wicker Study’, ‘Thursday, 3 September’, ‘Period 1 · week 1 of 8’, ‘Today’, ‘Nothing scheduled today’, ‘Practice now’, ‘Coming up’, ‘Course readiness’, ‘Read’, ‘Practice’, ‘Mistakes’, ‘Exam’, ‘BCS1540’, ‘Algorithmic Design’, ‘BCS1520’, ‘Statistics’, ‘Resume’, ‘Credits 0/60’, ‘Courses passed 0/14’, ‘Streak 0d’.
Constraints: functional academic UI; preserve real product meaning; accessible contrast; no marketing hero; no photography; no gradients; no glass; no oversized greeting; no generic metric-card grid; no decorative illustration; no vertical route; no large recommendation card; no invented commercial claims; no watermark.
